scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test:rust && npm run test && npm run clippy
scripts.dev: npm run build:wasm && vite --config demo/vite.config.ts demo
scripts.e2e:dist:build: npm run build -w liquiddom && npm run build -w @liquiddom/react && npm run build -w @liquiddom/vue && npm run build -w liquiddom-react-example --ignore-scripts && npm run build -w liquiddom-vue-example --ignore-scripts
scripts.e2e:site:build: npm run build -w liquiddom && npm run build -w @liquiddom/site
scripts.whole-picture: npm run e2e:site:build && playwright test e2e/record.spec.ts --project=record --project=record-webgpu && node scripts/webm-to-gif.mjs test-results/whole-picture/manifest.json docs/superpowers/whole-picture/slice-6-canvas2d.gif && node scripts/webm-to-gif.mjs test-results/whole-picture/manifest-webgpu.json docs/superpowers/whole-picture/slice-6-webgpu.gif && node scripts/webm-to-gif.mjs test-results/whole-picture/manifest-site.json docs/superpowers/whole-picture/slice-6-site-canvas2d.gif && node scripts/webm-to-gif.mjs test-results/whole-picture/manifest-site-webgpu.json docs/superpowers/whole-picture/slice-6-site-webgpu.gif
scripts.record:w72: playwright test e2e/record.spec.ts --project=record --project=record-webgpu && node scripts/webm-to-gif.mjs test-results/whole-picture/manifest.json docs/superpowers/whole-picture/slice-3-w72-canvas2d.gif && node scripts/webm-to-gif.mjs test-results/whole-picture/manifest-webgpu.json docs/superpowers/whole-picture/slice-3-w72-webgpu.gif
scripts.release: npm run build && npx changeset publish
